found: Every home interior in the project is an apartment. The manifest's 134 assets hold three domestic records, all in the apartment-ordinary family: canonical 03 and ordinary 02 (released, measured on disk at 1376x768 RGBA PNG, with 5504x3072 masters) and modest 01 (a 1376x768 master, unreleased). No other art family under art/families/ is residential. DOMESTIC_SCENE_IDS lists only canonical 03 and ordinary 02, and resolveLifeScene picks between them by hashing the household id, so where a life is has no bearing on the room.
shortfall: An apartment with brick blocks outside the window cannot stand for a house in a town of a few thousand. Drive was not searched: the bench exchange is the return path for delivered artwork, not a store of art nobody has asked for, and no request for a house interior has ever been filed.
generationRecipe: The living room of an ordinary detached single-family house in an American small town, seen first person from where a resident would stand, in the same drawn style as the released apartment living rooms.
Modest and lived-in: a couch, an armchair, a coffee table, a lamp, a television or bookshelf, a rug over wood or carpet. Nothing wealthy and nothing run-down.

Windows show a yard, a neighboring house or trees, framed so the season is not stated: no snow, no autumn color, no bare branches, or curtains drawn part-way. No apartment blocks, no city skyline, no brick street wall.
No people and no pets drawn in. Present household members are rendered separately on top.
No text, flags, party signs or anything that names a state or region.
acceptanceCriteria: Reads as a house, not an apartment: nothing visible through the window is a multi-story residential block or city street wall.
The window view states no season: a snowy, bare-branch or autumn-colored view is wrong for this request.
At least 4608 pixels wide at 16:9, measured from the delivered file, not upscaled from a smaller original.
Matches the drawing style of the released apartment living rooms closely enough to sit in the same game.

target.styleAuthority: The released apartment living rooms, art/families/apartment-ordinary/env_residence_apartment_living_canonical_03_v1.png and env_residence_apartment_living_ordinary_02_v1.png, which are the style reference the existing domestic request (env-domestic-living-room-4k-masters) was judged against.
